greeting: You're airborne with Tampa behind you and the coast ahead — Frankfurt overnight, then the short hop into Dubrovnik in the morning. The girls are with Jen for this stretch, so the trip is yours and Mike's.

needsAttention.title: Kerrie's waiting on the AI paper
needsAttention.detail: She replied to your governance docs asking for the AI paper you'd referred to. A quick send closes it before connectivity thins out on the water.

needsAttention.title: The Cavtat night for Sept 19 is still open
needsAttention.detail: The disembark-day room and the noon transfer from Komolac need booking from dry land — charter connectivity all but disappears once you're aboard on the 12th, so the window is really these next three days in Dubrovnik.

needsAttention.title: Halloween: St Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: It was due the 5th and it's still unmade, with the Oct 18 rotation booking set to fire while you're at sea. Better landed before the boat than from it, since three downstream bookings hang off the call.

schedule.title: Flight to Frankfurt
schedule.detail: UA 9661, Tampa to FRA, overnight; connects to Dubrovnik at 9:15 AM tomorrow

flagged.title: GitHub deploy token expired
flagged.detail: Your briefings-deploy access token lapsed today, worth regenerating next time you are at a real keyboard.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters and promos: Ridgeline, the Press Herald, HBO Max, Field, SiriusXM, Patreon.
inbox.clear: Nothing else in the inbox needs you tonight.

resolved.title: Croatia bags confirmed on the ticket
resolved.detail: Discover Airlines checked your two duffels through to Dubrovnik and sent the receipt, settling the checked-bag question that had been a P1 all week.

recipe.title: Apple Butterscotch Tart
recipe.why: Autumn brings the first crisp apples, and a butterscotch tart is the season's welcome to the orchard.

tasks.title: Message the Nautilus instructor to confirm boarding time and the return transfer
Book the St Pete landing-gap lodging, Sept 20 to 22
Orlando and Disney tickets for the six of you

acts.line: Last checkout at the St Pete ranch, house cleared by ten and the rental back to Tampa around noon.
Bags checked straight through to Dubrovnik, the receipt landing in your inbox before you left the counter.
Wheels up at 5:55 for the overnight to Frankfurt, then the short morning hop to the coast.
